clue.text: Together they may be expected to succeed

definitions.text: Together they may be expected to succeed

parts.words: Together they may be expected to succeed
parts.note: reads like people jointly expected to do well, but means people who jointly stand to inherit from the same person

explanation.surface: A pair of hopefuls tipped for joint success.
explanation.definitionFit: Joint heirs share an inheritance, so together they are expected to succeed to an estate or title.

clue.text: Food processor for fowls provided under contract gives farmer extra pickings

indicators.note: under in a down clue puts the bird's food pouch below the word for contract

parts.note: to contract an illness is to catch it
a crop is the pouch in a bird's gullet where food is processed

explanation.surface: A kitchen gadget for poultry supplied on contract earns a farmer extra income.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Food processor' wants to be a kitchen machine; it is a bird's crop.
explanation.definitionFit: A quick-growing crop sown between main crops gives a farmer an additional harvest.

clue.text: Imposing woman's in charge to keep order

indicators.note: to keep means the pieces hold the order within them

parts.note: her is the possessive for a woman
OM is the Order of Merit

explanation.surface: A commanding woman is put in charge of keeping order.
explanation.walkthrough: OM, the Order of Merit, is a British honour.
explanation.definitionFit: Epic in scale like the Iliad, something grand and heroic is impressive.

clue.text: When year is ending with no drink bad behaviour could result

parts.note: in December is when the year ends, Dec being its abbreviation
O is nought, nothing
rum is an alcoholic drink

explanation.surface: Without a drink at year's end, someone might start behaving badly.
explanation.definitionFit: Indecorum is a lack of propriety, unseemly conduct.

clue.text: Female content to pose riddle?

indicators.note: content, read as contained, means the female letter is held inside

parts.note: to sit for a portrait is to pose

explanation.surface: A woman is happy to set a puzzle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'riddle' looks like a puzzle; it is a coarse sieve.
explanation.definitionFit: A riddle is a coarse sieve, and passing material through one is sieving.

clue.text: Emphasise how rocket should be positioned?

explanation.surface: Stressing the correct orientation of a rocket on the launch pad.
explanation.definitionFit: To stress a point is to highlight it; a rocket on the pad should stand with its nose aimed at the sky.

clue.text: Fellow interrupting moral lesson may be excused

indicators.note: interrupting means the fellow breaks into the word for moral lesson

parts.note: a parable is a story teaching a moral
a don is a fellow of a college

explanation.surface: A college fellow cuts into a sermon and may be let off.
explanation.definitionFit: An excusable fault can be forgiven.

clue.text: Publish thin paper without leader

indicators.note: without leader means the first letter of the word for thin paper is dropped

parts.note: tissue is thin soft paper

explanation.surface: A newspaper printed on flimsy stock without its editorial.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without leader' drops the T of TISSUE.
explanation.definitionFit: To release a statement or edition is to put it out to the public.

clue.text: Leaves in batches ready for service in China, say

definitions.text: Leaves in batches ready for service in China, say

parts.words: Leaves in batches ready for service in China, say
parts.note: tea leaves come pre-packed in small portions, ready to brew in a china tea service

explanation.surface: Departures in groups ready for duty in China.
explanation.definitionFit: Small porous sachets hold measured tea leaves, ready for brewing in a china pot.

clue.text: Vegetable could be beet, we hear

explanation.surface: A beetroot as the vegetable in question.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is a soundalike: beet sounds like beat, a heartbeat.
explanation.definitionFit: Peas, beans and lentils are edible legume seeds; a regular throb of the heart is felt at the wrist.

clue.text: Note issue circulated as programmed

indicators.note: circulated means the word for issue is sent round the other way, read backwards

parts.note: to issue is to emit
D is a musical note

explanation.surface: A banknote put into circulation on schedule.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Note' looks like a banknote being issued; it is the musical note D, placed last although the clue names it first.
explanation.definitionFit: Something timed happens on a set schedule, just as a programmed event does.

clue.text: Stable gets initial course warning for baulk

parts.note: FORE is the shout of warning given at the start of a golf shot on the course
a stall is a compartment in a stable, here standing for the stable

explanation.surface: A racing stable hears an early warning about a course and decides to hold back.
explanation.walkthrough: FORE is the warning golfers shout to people ahead on the course.
explanation.definitionFit: To baulk is to thwart or hinder, and to forestall is to prevent by acting first.

clue.text: Old poet found re-writing a chore

indicators.note: re-writing means the letters of a chore are set down again in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone discovers that rewriting is a tedious chore.
explanation.definitionFit: The Roman lyric poet of the Odes, writing under Augustus, is a classic example of an ancient bard.

clue.text: Way to speed in the middle of the road

parts.note: a mode is a way or manner of doing something
rate means speed, as in a rate of knots

explanation.surface: A road-safety notice about how fast to drive in the centre lane.
explanation.definitionFit: A middle-of-the-road view avoids extremes, which is what a moderate position does.

clue.text: Voyager would be extremely clever, stowing into room at the back

indicators.note: stowing into means the letters are packed inside the other pieces

parts.note: space means room
aft means at the back, on a ship

indicators.note: extremely asks for the extremes of clever, its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A clever stowaway slips into a room at the rear of a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Voyager' is the name of NASA's deep-space probes, so it is an example of the answer rather than a synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: Voyager is the name of NASA probes sent to the outer planets, an example of an interplanetary vehicle.

clue.text: About to get poor dog to come back

parts.note: re means about or concerning
a cur is a worthless mongrel dog

explanation.surface: Someone is about to persuade a scruffy mongrel to return.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that comes back again and again happens repeatedly.

clue.text: Liquid diets after fish starter rejected by expert

indicators.note: after places the rearranged diets behind the fish
starter rejected means the fish that comes first is sent back, its letters read in reverse

parts.note: a carp is a freshwater fish

indicators.note: liquid means the letters of diets flow into a new order

explanation.surface: An expert rejects a fish starter in favour of liquid diets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Liquid' looks like an adjective for the diets but is the anagram signal; the fish is CARP, a word solvers must supply.
explanation.definitionFit: A practised hand is skilled through long experience, as an expert is.

clue.text: Easily controlled vehicle hoisted on board

indicators.note: on in a down clue puts the first piece above the board
hoisted in a down clue means the vehicle is lifted up, so read from bottom to top

parts.note: a cart is a vehicle
a table is a board, as in food and board

explanation.surface: A manageable vehicle is lifted onto a board.
explanation.definitionFit: Tractable means docile and manageable.

clue.text: Awful disgrace surrounding Henry's pardon

indicators.note: surrounding means the shuffled letters wrap around the unit letter
awful means the letters of disgrace are badly jumbled

parts.note: H is the symbol for the henry, the unit of inductance

explanation.surface: A dreadful scandal surrounds a pardon for King Henry.
explanation.definitionFit: To release someone from an obligation or penalty is to let them off.

clue.text: Controversial motorway dividing European state

indicators.note: dividing means the motorway is set between the two other pieces, splitting them

parts.note: a Pole is a European from Poland
Cal is an abbreviation for California, a US state
the M1 is Britain's first motorway, written MI in crosswords

explanation.surface: A row over a motorway project that splits a European country.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 is a British motorway, read as MI.
explanation.definitionFit: Polemical writing is combative and argumentative, stirring up dispute.

clue.text: Indulgent, as illustrated by Tenniel's characters

indicators.note: characters means the letters of the name are rearranged

parts.note: John Tenniel, the illustrator of Alice in Wonderland; the possessive adds no letter

explanation.surface: Tenniel's illustrated figures in Alice look soft and forgiving.
explanation.walkthrough: 'characters' rearranges TENNIEL; the surface plays on his Alice drawings.
explanation.definitionFit: Being lenient means being merciful and tolerant.

clue.text: Collect for a service

parts.note: Mass is a church service

explanation.surface: A collection taken at a church service.
explanation.definitionFit: To amass is to gather or accumulate a quantity of something.

clue.text: Melody to boost upward mobility

parts.note: an air is a tune or melody
to lift is to boost or raise

explanation.surface: A tune intended to raise someone's social standing.
explanation.definitionFit: Moving supplies or people by aircraft is literally transport that goes upwards.

clue.text: Hesitate to suspend game defender

parts.note: to suspend something is to hang it
a back is a defensive player in football or hockey

explanation.surface: Someone pauses before suspending a defender from a match.
explanation.definitionFit: To hang back is to hold off from acting, showing reluctance.

clue.text: Shrink from covering Southern expedition

indicators.note: covering means the word for shrink from goes around the southern letter

parts.note: to hate is to shrink from in loathing

explanation.surface: Backing away from leading a southern expedition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'expedition' looks like a journey; here it means speed.
explanation.definitionFit: Expedition can mean promptness or speed of action, as hurry does.

clue.text: People getting workers' support for boycott

parts.note: to ban something is to boycott it
TU is a trade union, which backs workers

explanation.surface: People get trade-union backing for a boycott.
explanation.definitionFit: A large group of related peoples of central and southern Africa.

clue.text: Formality recognised in way to bow

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way
an arch is a bow or curved structure

explanation.surface: A formal custom of bowing that is recognised on the street.
explanation.definitionFit: Starch in manner means stiff, prim formality.

clue.text: Manage daily perhaps to get upstream

indicators.note: to get upstream in a down clue means read from the bottom up

parts.note: the tide comes in and goes out daily

explanation.surface: A paper's editor handles a daily newspaper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'daily' suggests a newspaper, which is what one edits; here it describes the tide.
explanation.definitionFit: To edit a publication is to run or direct it.

clue.text: Direction of tail showing bird nesting in grass

indicators.note: nesting in means the bird sits inside the word for grass

parts.note: a sward is a stretch of grassy turf
a tern is a seabird

explanation.surface: A bird's tail is visible as it nests in the grass.
explanation.definitionFit: The stern is a ship's rear, so going toward it means heading to the tail end.

clue.text: Pipe lines? That's right

parts.note: BR stands for British Rail, its railway lines
ie, from Latin id est, means that is

explanation.surface: A question about a pipe's lines, answered with confirmation.
explanation.walkthrough: BR, British Rail, stands for railway lines.
explanation.definitionFit: A tobacco pipe carved from heath root takes its name from that wood.

clue.text: Give responsibility in field event, rustic style

indicators.note: in field says the letters lie within the stretch of words that follows

explanation.surface: Someone is put in charge of a country-style field event.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer runs through evENT RUSTic.
explanation.definitionFit: To place a duty in someone's care is to hand them a charge.

clue.text: Letters drafted to give support to Board

indicators.note: drafted means the letters are drawn up again in a different arrangement

explanation.surface: Letters are drawn up to back a company board.
explanation.definitionFit: A trestle is a frame on which a board or tabletop rests.
